req-1.summary: Flow replacements absorb an untouched following sibling
req-1.fix: Require each contextual replacement block to retain its standalone end offset as well as type/start. If the target has a following sibling, require that sibling in the same projected parent at its original start plus the splice length delta, preserving its boundary/type. Return existing UnsupportedTarget on absorption. Add immediate heading/paragraph and blank-separated list/code/blockquote regressions, plus table and definition continuation cases. Coordinate the dialect-aware reparse with req-7; record the verified upstream bug centrally under section 14.

req-2.summary: Phrasing replacement whitespace invalidates an enclosing delimiter
req-2.fix: When the replacement reaches a delimiter-bearing ancestor’s closing boundary, encode its terminal whitespace as character references so the closing delimiter remains valid, or return typed `UnsupportedTarget` for that unsafe splice. Add regressions for emphasis, strong, and delete text children and record the upstream bug.

req-3.summary: Underscore formatting misclassifies combining and format characters
req-3.fix: Evaluate the proposed underscore delimiters using the parser’s actual whitespace, punctuation, and flanking rules, and skip unsafe rewrites. Add U+0301 and U+200C regressions, including one-sided and two-sided neighbors, and record the upstream bug.

req-4.summary: Nested-link precheck overflows before typed depth validation
req-4.fix: Run the descendant-link check after `Markdown.stringifyResult` has successfully validated the fragment’s depth, or make that check iterative and depth bounded with a typed `FragmentUnrenderable` result. Add a regression proving that an over-deep fragment inside a link fails through the typed channel.

req-5.fix: Define an annotated module-local TaggedEdit schema and derive its same-name type, reusing existing edit field schemas. Keep plain-object records, all six fields and formatter behavior. Check the existing formatter regressions. The resulting law-forced recording belongs to the central per-class deviation codemod; do not edit Port notes or PORT_LEDGER.json.

req-6.summary: Setext heading conversion can become HTML or a reference definition
req-6.fix: Before emitting a setext replacement, parse `` `${content}\n${underline}\n` `` with the same dialect `format` used. Emit only when that parse is a single setext heading of the same depth and text. Leave the ATX heading untouched otherwise.

req-7.summary: Flow safety reparse loses the original parse dialect
req-7.fix: Persist the resolved parse dialect on MarkdownDocument using the existing MarkdownDialect schema and a gfm default, populate it in MarkdownDocument.parseResult, and pass it into both standalone and contextual reparses in MarkdownFormat.modify. Combine with req-1 boundary validation. Add commonmark/GFM paired modification regressions. Record the verified parsing-contract bug centrally under section 14; keep changes within these two source files and their tests.

req-8.summary: One synthetic list position suppresses real item gaps
req-8.fix: Treat the list as positionless only when fewer than two children have a non-synthetic position, and return `node.spread ?? false` in that case. Otherwise run the existing gap loop over the non-synthetic children in order. Keep the all-sentinel behaviour `mdast.test.ts:176` pins, and add the mixed line-1 / line-3 / omitted-position case.

req-9.summary: Engine errors still extend Data.TaggedError instead of S.TaggedError
req-9.fix: Derive RawMarkdownError and GuardExceeded directly from annotated S.TaggedError schemas, reusing the existing schema-backed diagnostic and reason domain. Preserve tags, name = Error, messages, positional new constructors and instanceof guards. Retarget carrier tests only where the schema constructor requires it. This is the still-missing migration, not recording alone; the law-forced bookkeeping remains central.

req-10.summary: MDX fragment attribute checks lack shared filter metadata
req-10.fix: Declare one module-level filter, `S.makeFilter` with `identifier`, `title`, `description`, and the existing message `"an MDX JSX fragment cannot carry attributes"`, and pass that filter to both `S.check` calls.

req-11.summary: Setext promotion spreads an unbounded source-segment array
req-11.fix: Copy the segments with an iterative loop instead of argument spreading. Add a Node regression for the 150,000-line setext heading, asserting successful parsing and retained source positions, and record the verified upstream bug through section 14.

req-12.summary: Deep acyclic foreign mdast input overflows normalization
req-12.fix: Add an iterative admission preflight that checks a documented safe foreign-tree depth budget before recursive normalization and schema decoding. Return `MdastDecodeError` with a structured `SchemaIssue.InvalidValue` when that budget is exceeded. Preserve shared acyclic subtrees and supported foreign trees above the visitor’s separate depth limit; add regressions for both entry points and record the upstream-bug deviation.

req-13.summary: Link opener deactivation continues scanning after all active links clear
req-13.fix: Include `this.activeLinkOpeners > 0` in the traversal’s continuation condition, or break immediately after the count reaches zero. Add a scaled bracket-visit regression and record the verified upstream performance bug.

req-14.summary: Four immutable parser payloads remain handwritten interfaces
req-14.fix: Define annotated S.Struct values for RawInlineSlice, PreparedInline, DefinitionData and FootnoteData and derive same-name types. Reuse existing node/content schemas and RawInlineSegment; retain plain-object construction and exact field optionality. Add focused schema acceptance/round-trip regressions to the existing blockTypes property test. Do not turn this into a module-wide S3 coverage or canon assignment; recording and added exports are central.

req-15.summary: Parser continue/start verdicts lack named literal schemas
req-15.fix: Define annotated `LiteralKit([0, 1, 2])` values for the two verdict domains and derive their same-name types. Retain the existing numeric codes and scanner behavior.

req-16.summary: Underscore serialization loses emphasis at unsafe neighboring code points
req-16.fix: Before keeping `_`, classify the previous output code point (step back over a valid surrogate pair) and, when the next sibling is text, its first code point. If either is a Unicode letter or number, emit `*`. Add regressions for `𐐀_a_`, `_a_b`, and the strong forms.

req-17.summary: Destination and title line endings serialize as active block syntax
req-17.fix:
After escaping literal ampersands, encode CR/LF as /
 in the pointy destination spelling and in titleSuffix, preserving the existing quote/destination escapes. Add link, image and definition round-trips for both line endings and blank-line titles. Exclude unrepresentable NUL from this fix. Record the verified upstream bug centrally under section 14.

req-18.summary: Metadata without language becomes a language class
req-18.fix: When `lang` is absent, emit an empty info string. No first word unescapes to `""`, so metadata cannot occupy that slot and keep the class absent. Add a regression that this node re-renders without `language-tail`.

req-19.summary: Metadata-only fenced blocks acquire loose-list separators
req-19.fix: Treat `meta !== undefined` as a fence in `interruptsParagraph` and in both sides of the code clause of `canJoinWithoutBlank`, the same condition `serializeCode` already uses. Add a tight-list regression for a paragraph followed by metadata-only code.

req-20.summary: Table segment spreads exceed Node argument limits
req-20.fix: Append `content.segments` iteratively. Apply the same bounded append to the table module’s other unbounded segment spreads at lines 396 and 586. Add a focused Node regression for the escaped-pipe cell and record the upstream bug under section 14.

req-21.summary: Decoded carriage returns become new block boundaries
req-21.fix: Emit decoded CR as `` in canonical text escaping so it remains inline content rather than a source-line boundary. Add paragraph and image-alt regressions with block-opening characters after decoded CR, and record the upstream bug under section 14.

req-22.summary: Decoded spaces turn a soft newline into a hard break
req-22.fix:
Emit `
` instead of a physical newline when the preceding emitted text would make it a hard break. Account for adjoining Text siblings as well as spaces within one value. Add the decoded-space regression and record the upstream bug under section 14.

req-23.summary: Table header promotion rescans provenance quadratically
req-23.fix: Maintain a forward segment cursor while processing the ordered escape-drop intervals, visiting each source segment and drop once. Preserve the current source offsets and resulting segment boundaries. Add a segment-read bound regression and record the algorithmic upstream bug under section 14.

req-24.summary: Leading tilde language text lengthens a tilde fence
req-24.fix: After the existing replacements, encode one leading `~` as `~` when the fence character is `~`. Add a round-trip for `lang: "~"` and `lang: "~~x"` with `fenceChar: "~"`.

req-25.fix: Define a file-local, annotated `EmailMatch` schema and derive the same-name type from it. Use nonnegative integer schemas for the merged-text offsets and a string schema for the destination. Keep the existing plain-object records, matching algorithm, and export surface.
